references.text: The same list of Reuben's sons: Hanok, Pallu, Hesron and Karmi are mentioned when Jacob's family goes down to Egypt.
Reuben is named as Israel's firstborn son, born to Leah.
The same genealogical list of Reuben's descendants is repeated in the census on the plains of Moab.
Reuben's sons Hanok, Pallu, Hesron and Karmi are mentioned in the genealogies of Chronicles.
Reuben is named as Jacob's firstborn son.
The tribe of Reuben and his descendants are counted in the first census in the wilderness.
Expands the genealogy from names to the formation of specific tribes.
Connects the early genealogical list to the later official count of the tribe.
Explains theologically why Reuben's status as firstborn in Exodus did not lead to the birthright.
